entry_batch.aggregate_rule: each raw-total row candidate/baseline ratio 95% CI upper bound <= 1.05
entry_batch.purpose: supplement focused-stage evidence; never replace the focused gate

cold_churn.rows: uniform66 cold and FIFO churn schedule at threshold 3 only
cold_churn.aggregate_rule: each cold event-class p99 and max candidate/baseline ratio 95% CI upper bound <= 1.05
cold_churn.delayed_compile_behavior: a measured spike may honestly reject or leave the result inconclusive

decision.owner: the combined P066 proof producer, once
decision.rule: retain the existing focused and semantic gates; every focused row, protected cold control, held-out row, build/dependency/provenance gate, entry-total raw row, and cold/churn event-class p99/max gate must pass

ratio_classification.meaning: reject when the entire confidence interval exceeds the bound; otherwise a confidence interval crossing the bound is inconclusive

limitations: A candidate promotion requires the single combined gate to pass; threshold 3 is predeclared and is not optimized from these measurements.
The three P066 semantic cases supplement and do not replace any retained P132, P133, P134, or P138 semantic gates.
P135 benchmark-driver tests execute in their own harness test group; P135 names are not runtime integration-test selectors.
